meta.note: Molecular look v3 locked 2026-11-11; tissue looks locked 2026-11-10 and 11. Molecular lengths are in SVG pixels at 10 px per ångström, the scale of the molecule icons. Sources of truth in the repository: pipeline/icons/molecule_depth.py (molecules), assets/icons/palette_v4.json, pipeline/organs/*.py (tissue).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The veil that eases a picture back while something is named, and the ground of title cards. Never pure white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Captions, labels and the double plate frame, always on paper. At tissue scale also the outline of a whole structure (an acinus, the gland, a villus contour, a vessel wall). Never a line on a molecule, never a nucleus.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Label lines, scene codes and scale-bar text, on paper.

tokens.name: extra-ground
tokens.usage: Extracellular field at molecular scale: a quiet pink. Outside the cell is where the blood is, so this ground continues the rose of the blood. The upper half of every membrane frame, the whole field for albumin and other molecules in plasma. Changed over with the intracellular colour on 2026-11-11.

tokens.name: extra-line
tokens.usage: Lattice lines of the six-fold rosette on extra-ground, 0.4 Å wide. A deeper tint of the ground: decorative, quiet by design.

tokens.name: extra-tile
tokens.usage: The six-pointed star tiles inside the extracellular hexagons.

tokens.name: intra-ground
tokens.usage: Intracellular field at molecular scale: a honey ochre, kin to the honey of the pancreas cells. The lower half of every membrane frame, the whole field for molecules inside the cell. Changed over with the extracellular colour on 2026-11-11.

tokens.name: intra-line
tokens.usage: Lattice lines of the six-petal flowers on intra-ground, 0.4 Å wide. A deeper tint of the ground.

tokens.name: intra-tile
tokens.usage: First petal tint of the intracellular flowers; alternates with intra-tile-2 around each flower.

tokens.name: intra-tile-2
tokens.usage: Second petal tint of the intracellular flowers.

tokens.name: bilayer-fill
tokens.usage: The 36 Å bilayer band between the two fields: amber, a step fuller than either field so it reads as a different material.

tokens.name: bilayer-line
tokens.usage: Bilayer edge lines (0.6 Å), head outlines, tail zig-zags and the faint midline.

tokens.name: bilayer-head
tokens.usage: Round lipid head tiles, 3 Å radius at 7 Å pitch, one row per leaflet facing outward.

tokens.name: mol-glp1r
tokens.usage: GLP-1 receptor in every complex. Sage green (teal #639d95 until 2026-11-12, when the drug turned slate blue and the three molecules of the complex were given three plainly different colours). A molecule keeps one colour everywhere in the film. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-glp1r-line
tokens.usage: Outline of GLP-1R: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-semaglutide
tokens.usage: Semaglutide, the drug: slate blue, a step deeper than the rest so that it stands apart from the receptor that holds it. Crimson #b24561 until 2026-11-12: when it is injected the drug is a pale blue liquid (see the Depot card), so its molecule is blue too. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-semaglutide-line
tokens.usage: Outline of semaglutide: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-gprotein
tokens.usage: Gs and Go, all chains: mauve (slate blue #8793ac until 2026-11-12; the drug took the slate). The chains share the fill; the outline marks where one ends. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-gprotein-line
tokens.usage: Outline of G protein: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-exendin4
tokens.usage: Exendin-4: warm taupe. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-exendin4-line
tokens.usage: Outline of exendin-4: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-albumin
tokens.usage: Serum albumin: straw. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-albumin-line
tokens.usage: Outline of albumin: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-insulin-receptor
tokens.usage: Insulin receptor ectodomain: cool grey-lilac. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-insulin-receptor-line
tokens.usage: Outline of insulin receptor: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-insulin
tokens.usage: Insulin: brick rose. It never shares a frame with semaglutide at the same scale. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-insulin-line
tokens.usage: Outline of insulin: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-glut4
tokens.usage: GLUT4, the sugar gate: a dusty rose (a sage green until 2026-11-12, which the GLP-1 receptor's new green came too close to). Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-glut4-line
tokens.usage: Outline of GLUT4: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-adenylyl-cyclase
tokens.usage: Adenylyl cyclase 9: steel blue. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-adenylyl-cyclase-line
tokens.usage: Outline of adenylyl cyclase: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-pi3k-p110
tokens.usage: PI3K catalytic subunit p110: teal, the teal the GLP-1 receptor had until 2026-11-12 (p110 was a mauve too near the G protein's new one). Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-pi3k-p110-line
tokens.usage: Outline of PI3K p110: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-pi3k-p85
tokens.usage: PI3K regulatory subunit p85: olive straw. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-pi3k-p85-line
tokens.usage: Outline of PI3K p85: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-rgs
tokens.usage: RGS16: clay. Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-rgs-line
tokens.usage: Outline of RGS: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: mol-adiponectin
tokens.usage: Adiponectin: a deeper leaf green (a teal-green until 2026-11-12, which PI3K's teal came too close to). Fill; its light shape is this mixed 28% toward mol-light, its shadow shape this mixed 32% toward its own outline colour.

tokens.name: mol-adiponectin-line
tokens.usage: Outline of adiponectin: the fill shaded to 55%. Every molecule outline is computed this way, never chosen.

tokens.name: wash-pancreas
tokens.usage: Tier 3: the pancreas, a honey wash under an ink outline. Lobules are toned from it toward shadow-pancreas or light-pancreas, never darkened. Locked 2026-11-10 on zoom sheet v5.

tokens.name: wash-gut
tokens.usage: Tier 3: the gut, a pink set apart from the honey pancreas. Enterocytes of the villi field. Locked 2026-11-10 (pink sheet v1, a third of the way from rose to orchid).

tokens.name: wash-brain
tokens.usage: Placeholder, not yet workshopped: brain, hypothalamus and brainstem wash. It will get its own hue family, with a shadow and a light hue, on a sheet of options.

tokens.name: wash-liver
tokens.usage: Placeholder, not yet workshopped: liver wash. It will get its own hue family, with a shadow and a light hue, on a sheet of options.

tokens.name: wash-adipose
tokens.usage: Placeholder, not yet workshopped: adipose tissue wash. Pale by nature (1.3:1 on paper); its ink line carries the form. It will get its own hue family, with a shadow and a light hue, on a sheet of options.

tokens.name: wash-muscle
tokens.usage: Placeholder, not yet workshopped: skeletal and heart muscle wash. It will get its own hue family, with a shadow and a light hue, on a sheet of options.

tokens.name: wash-nerve
tokens.usage: Placeholder, not yet workshopped: the vagus and other nerves, drawn as traced fibres in this wash with an ink line. It will get its own hue family, with a shadow and a light hue, on a sheet of options.

tokens.name: wash-blood
tokens.usage: Red blood cells at tier 2: coral red discs at every tilt, shaded toward blood-wine in the hollow and lit with blood-glow on the rim. Locked 2026-11-11.

tokens.name: wash-vessel
tokens.usage: The lining of a vessel at tier 2: flat endothelial cells one cell thick, with plum nuclei that bulge into the lumen.

tokens.name: silhouette
tokens.usage: Tier 4: the body silhouette, traced from the reference figure, 175 cm, no face, one flat lavender tint on paper; the lit organ is the only warm colour inside it.

tokens.name: duotone-mid
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Tier 4 archive photographs: midtone of the duotone between ink (shadows) and paper (highlights). No other colour on a photograph.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Data plates, series 1 (amber): glucose and energy. Series order is fixed, never cycled; a series keeps its colour when others are hidden. Lines carry direct labels, so 2.1:1 on paper is accepted.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Data plates, series 2 (rose): semaglutide, the treated arm, the drug. Kin to mol-semaglutide.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Data plates, series 3 (teal): GLP-1, the receptor, incretin signals. Kin to mol-glp1r. Direct-labelled (2.9:1).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Data plates, series 4 (blue): placebo, control, baseline. The four pass the colour-vision checks in this order; never add a fifth hue, fold it into Other or a second plate.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Proposal, not yet workshopped. Hairline grid on data plates, 1.25:1 on paper, recessive. Axis lines and tick labels are ink-muted; titles and values are ink.

tokens.name: wash-duodenum
tokens.usage: Tier 3: the duodenal C the head of the pancreas sits in, with a lit edge and a shadow edge; no line crosses the head.

tokens.name: wash-acinar
tokens.usage: Tier 2 and 3: the base of an acinar cell. Acini are rosettes of 6 to 9 pyramidal cells around a lumen, nucleus basal, granules apical, a heavier ink wall around each acinus.

tokens.name: cell-beta
tokens.usage: Islet beta cells, through the core. A rose related to the insulin tint.

tokens.name: cell-alpha
tokens.usage: Islet alpha cells: toward the rim (62% of the cells touching an acinus) and along the capillaries (40% of the cells beside one). Never a closed ring. A relative of the beta rose, not a new hue.

tokens.name: cell-delta
tokens.usage: Islet delta cells, about 8%, scattered. A deeper relative of the beta rose.

tokens.name: capillary
tokens.usage: The wall of a capillary cut across. Capillaries are never running lines, plain red blobs or pale openings with loose red dots. In an islet each takes a whole cell-place (about one per 22 cells); in the acinar bed each sits in a soft-cornered pocket the acini are cut back around.

tokens.name: shadow-pancreas
tokens.usage: The shadow hue of the pancreas family. A surface turned from the light moves toward this violet; stipple is drawn in it. Shade by hue, never by multiplying a colour darker.

tokens.name: light-pancreas
tokens.usage: The light hue of the pancreas family. A lit surface moves toward this butter.

tokens.name: duodenum-opening
tokens.usage: The cut opening of the duodenal tube, a deeper rose so it reads as a hollow and not as paper.

tokens.name: wash-acinar-apex
tokens.usage: The granule-filled apex of an acinar cell at the lumen. Each acinus is washed from this to wash-acinar: a radial wash close up, two flat steps at the lobule scale.

tokens.name: capillary-deep
tokens.usage: The blood inside a capillary: a deeper red than the wall, so the section reads as a hollow you look into.

tokens.name: nucleus
tokens.usage: Cell nuclei at tiers 2 and 3: plum, not ink. Near-black nuclei pepper a frame and fight the subject.

tokens.name: cell-wall
tokens.usage: Inner cell walls at tiers 2 and 3. Ink is kept for the outline of a whole structure: an acinus, the gland, a villus contour.

tokens.name: halo-organ
tokens.usage: Tier 4: the warm halo around the one lit organ inside the silhouette.

tokens.name: cell-goblet
tokens.usage: Goblet cells in the gut lining: 9% of cells, paler, a dot at the centre.

tokens.name: cell-l
tokens.usage: L cells in the gut lining, about 3 in 1000: the teal of the GLP-1 receptor family, the only cool accent in the villi field.

tokens.name: shadow-gut
tokens.usage: The shadow hue of the gut family: the side of a villus turned from the light moves toward this violet.

tokens.name: light-gut
tokens.usage: The light hue of the gut family: the lit side of a villus moves toward this cream.

tokens.name: crypt-deep
tokens.usage: The deep of a crypt in the gut lining. Cells going down a pit move toward shadow-gut and then toward this; it is never used as a flat fill for a hole.

tokens.name: lumen-ground
tokens.usage: The gut lumen: the cream ground and the first of three tile tints of its honeycomb.

tokens.name: lumen-tile-blush
tokens.usage: Gut lumen honeycomb: the blush tile. No two tiles of one tint sit side by side.

tokens.name: lumen-tile-apricot
tokens.usage: Gut lumen honeycomb: the apricot tile. Tint tiles toward pink and apricot; cream mixed toward violet goes grey.

tokens.name: lumen-ribbon
tokens.usage: Gut lumen: the wandering ribbons, arcs across each hexagon turned at random so they join into loops.

tokens.name: lumen-ribbon-edge
tokens.usage: Gut lumen: the edge on each side of a ribbon and, a little deeper, the beads down its middle.

tokens.name: wash-lamina
tokens.usage: The lamina propria in the core of a villus: loose cells as one Voronoi, a dusky mauve of the gut family.

tokens.name: lacteal
tokens.usage: The lacteal in the middle of a villus core: a pale lymph vessel with a wall, drawn as the capillaries are.

tokens.name: granule-l
tokens.usage: Secretory granules in the L cell, crowded toward its base, and docked along the base at release.

tokens.name: plume-glp1
tokens.usage: GLP-1 leaving the L cell at tier 2: a fine plume of small dots crossing the basement line and thinning out inside the capillary.

tokens.name: blood-wine
tokens.usage: The shadow hue of the blood family: the hollow of a red cell and its outline.

tokens.name: blood-glow
tokens.usage: The light hue of the blood family: a short light on the rim of a red cell.

tokens.name: blood-ground
tokens.usage: The ground inside a vessel: a rose red that rhymes with the capillary wall of the tissue frames without matching it. No apricot or straw: it reads yellow.

tokens.name: blood-tile-1
tokens.usage: Blood pavement: one of three rose tints of the soft-cornered cells of the ground pattern; no two alike side by side.

tokens.name: blood-tile-2
tokens.usage: Blood pavement: one of three rose tints of the soft-cornered cells of the ground pattern; no two alike side by side.

tokens.name: blood-tile-3
tokens.usage: Blood pavement: one of three rose tints of the soft-cornered cells of the ground pattern; no two alike side by side.

tokens.name: blood-line
tokens.usage: Blood pavement: the line round each cell of the ground pattern.

tokens.name: blood-far
tokens.usage: The far layer of red cells inside a vessel: pale, sparse, always whole; it moves slower than the near cells and faster than the ground.

tokens.name: cell-white
tokens.usage: A white blood cell: one to a frame, smooth outline, close in value to the ground, lobed nucleus only a step deeper. What is not red in the blood is lilac.

tokens.name: platelet
tokens.usage: Platelets: small lilac ovals a third the width of a red cell, with two or three specks.

tokens.name: mol-light
tokens.usage: The light every molecule is lit toward. The quarter of a molecule's real surface that faces the light (upper left) is drawn as one flat shape in the fill mixed 28% toward this.

tokens.name: mol-shadow-tint
tokens.usage: A touch of this violet (10%) goes into every molecule's shadow shape, on top of the 32% toward its own outline colour, so shadows lean cool.

tokens.name: type-cloud
tokens.usage: The soft cream of two things: the cloud behind ink type and the scale bar over a picture at full strength, and the pulsing halo round a thing being named. Always soft-edged; never a box or a crisp ring.

tokens.name: cavity-ground
tokens.usage: Inside the body, between the organs: a clean light lavender taken from the silhouette. Mixing the silhouette with cream paper goes grey; do not.

tokens.name: cavity-vessel
tokens.usage: The vessel tree of the body field, and the line of the hinted neighbouring organs.

tokens.name: cavity-vessel-core
tokens.usage: A hint of red down the middle of every vessel wide enough to hold a line: the blood inside. Only a hint; a stronger red was too hard.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Film title and act titles on paper, 1080p frame; double for 4K. Ink.

styles.name: plate-title
styles.sample: Plate V.  The GLP-1 receptor with semaglutide and Gs.
styles.usage: The caption line under a plate: roman number, two spaces, a full sentence with a full stop. Ink. 1080p frame; double for 4K.

styles.name: plate-caption
styles.sample: the drug sits in the receptor's pocket, the G protein below
styles.usage: The descriptive clause of a caption, italic, following the roman title on the same baseline or the next line.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Discovered in Toronto in 1921, insulin reached a ward within months.
styles.usage: Longer notes on tier-4 history plates and title cards. Ink or ink-muted on paper.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The technical line under a caption: PDB id, method, scale. Ink-muted on paper and ochre, ink on dusky. Letterspaced, never bold.

styles.name: scene-code
styles.usage: Scene codes, tier markers and render stamps in the plate margin. Uppercase, ink-muted.

styles.name: molecule-label
styles.usage: A molecule's name beside it on the field, lowercase as in palette_v3.json, set in its own outline colour (mol-…-line) so the label belongs to the shape.

spacing.note: Molecular scale: 10 px per ångström, the scale the SVG icons are drawn at. The renderer scales all of these with the camera.

tokens.name: angstrom
tokens.usage: One ångström at icon scale. Every other length is a multiple of this.

tokens.name: head-radius
tokens.usage: 3 Å lipid head radius in the bilayer mosaic.

tokens.name: head-pitch
tokens.usage: 7 Å pitch between lipid heads along each leaflet.

tokens.name: cell-intra
tokens.usage: 12 Å hexagon side (circumradius, 20.8 Å across flats): the cell of the intracellular flowers at tier 1. Double it at tier 2.

tokens.name: cell-extra
tokens.usage: 16 Å hexagon side (circumradius, 27.7 Å across flats): the cell of the extracellular rosettes at tier 1. Double it at tier 2.

tokens.name: bilayer
tokens.usage: 36 Å bilayer thickness, centred on the median screen height of the protein's transmembrane residues.

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: Type and the scale bar keep this far from the frame edge at 1280 wide (a little under 5% of the width).

tokens.name: radius-facet
tokens.usage: 0.5 Å rounding on every molecule facet corner, mitre joins otherwise. The only rounding a molecule gets.

tokens.name: radius-head
tokens.usage: Lipid heads are discs: radius equals head-radius.

line.note: Stroke widths at 10 px per ångström.

tokens.name: line-outline
tokens.usage: 0.5 Å molecule outline in the molecule's own mol-…-line colour. The only line a molecule has.

tokens.name: line-field
tokens.usage: 0.4 Å lattice line on both fields, in extra-line or intra-line.

tokens.name: line-bilayer-edge
tokens.usage: 0.6 Å top and bottom edge of the bilayer, bilayer-line.

tokens.name: line-bilayer
tokens.usage: 0.35 Å head outlines and tail zig-zags, bilayer-line.

tokens.name: line-midline
tokens.usage: 0.25 Å bilayer midline, bilayer-line at opacity-midline.

tokens.name: line-organ-hero
tokens.usage: 1080p frame: the ink outline of a whole structure at tissue scale (the gland, an acinus, a villus contour, the line under a vessel wall). Inner cell walls are cell-wall, thinner.

tokens.name: line-chart
tokens.usage: Proposed, 1080p frame: data lines on a data plate; markers 8px discs with a 2px paper ring.

tokens.name: line-chart-grid
tokens.usage: Proposed, 1080p frame: chart grid and axes.

tokens.name: opacity-midline
tokens.usage: The bilayer midline where tails meet.

tokens.name: opacity-tooth
tokens.usage: Paper grain: fine monochrome specks on paper, the same strength in every frame.

tokens.name: opacity-field-tier-1
tokens.usage: Lattice line opacity at molecular scale. At tissue scale there is no molecular lattice: each kind of space has its own pattern (see Fields and texture).

tokens.name: opacity-veil
tokens.usage: Naming: a veil of paper at this strength over the whole picture while something is named. The named thing is redrawn on top at full strength, inside its halo. (The backup list uses a heavier veil, 0.68.)
